"""公开门面：:class:`MetaCatalog`。

组合注册簿、Schema 校验、字段级比较、影响分析与全文检索。所有成功结果都以
普通 dict/list 返回（可直接 JSON 序列化）；注册、比较、读取与检索均不会改动
既有 Schema 的注册内容、版本关系与资产依赖关系。
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import copy
from typing import Any

from . import audit as audit_mod
from . import compare as compare_mod
from . import schema_fields as sf
from . import upgrade as upgrade_mod
from .errors import NotFoundError, SchemaComparisonInvalid
from .explain import explain_field
from .impact import analyze_field
from .registry import FieldRef, Registry
from .search import SearchIndex
from .validator import validate_schema


class MetaCatalog:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._registry = Registry()
        self._index = SearchIndex()
        self._reports: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
        self._indexed_reports: set[str] = set()

    # ============================================================ 注册：Schema
    def register_schema(self, name: str, version: str, document: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """注册一个不可变的 Schema 版本。文档不合法时抛 SchemaComparisonInvalid。"""
        validate_schema(document)
        record = self._registry.register_schema(name, version, document)
        self._index_schema(record.name, record.version, record.document, record.title)
        return self.get_schema(name, version)

    def get_schema(self, name: str, version: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        record = self._registry.get_schema(name, version)
        return {
            "name": record.name,
            "version": record.version,
            "title": record.title,
            "document": copy.deepcopy(record.document),
        }

    def list_versions(self, name: str) -> list[str]:
        return self._registry.list_versions(name)

    # ============================================================== 注册：资产
    def register_asset(
        self,
        asset_id: str,
        name: str,
        kind: str,
        refs: list[dict[str, Any]] | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """注册目录资产。

        ``refs`` 为 ``[{"schema": 名, "version": 版本, "path": 字段指针}, ...]``，
        表示资产对字段的直接引用；路径可写文档指针（``/properties/a``）或
        逻辑字段路径（``/a``），注册时统一规整。
        """
        asset = self._registry.register_asset(asset_id, name, kind, refs or [])
        self._index_asset(asset.id, asset.name, asset.kind, list(asset.refs))
        return self._asset_view(asset)

    def get_asset(self, asset_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return self._asset_view(self._registry.get_asset(asset_id))

    @staticmethod
    def _asset_view(asset) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "asset_id": asset.id,
            "name": asset.name,
            "kind": asset.kind,
            "refs": [
                {"schema": r.schema, "version": r.version, "path": r.path}
                for r in asset.refs
            ],
        }

    # ================================================================ 影响分析
    def analyze_impact(self, name: str, version: str, path: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """字段级影响分析：返回直接引用资产与经其他 Schema 传递引用的资产。"""
        return analyze_field(self._registry, name, version, path)

    # ============================================================ 影响链路解释
    def explain_impact(
        self,
        name: str,
        version: str,
        path: str,
        asset_ids: list[str] | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """按资产解释指定 Schema 版本中逻辑字段的影响链路（只读）。

        ``asset_ids`` 为 ``None`` 时覆盖全部资产；指定时去重且不考虑顺序，
        空列表不选任何资产，未知资产抛 :class:`NotFoundError`。所查 Schema、
        版本不存在或字段不可达时同样抛 :class:`NotFoundError`。

        返回 ``schema``、``version``、``path`` 与按 ``asset_id`` 升序的
        ``assets``；每个资产含 ``impact_kind``（``direct`` / ``transitive``
        / ``both``）与 ``chains``。直接命中是零步链（``source == target ==
        所查字段``）；传递命中给出沿跨 Schema ``$ref`` 的实际步进链，同一
        ``(source, target)`` 只保留一条最短链（等长取步进定位元组稳定最小
        者）。超过既有链深度、引用边或资产上限时抛
        :class:`ImpactAnalysisTooLarge`。

        本调用只读现有注册内容：不注册资源、不生成报告、不写入检索索引；
        返回值为独立副本，相同输入得到相同结果。
        """
        return explain_field(self._registry, name, version, path, asset_ids)

    # ============================================================ 引用完整性审计
    def check_schema_references(
        self, name: str | None = None, version: str | None = None
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """审计已注册 Schema 版本中的跨 Schema ``$ref`` 完整性（只读）。

        无参数审计全部版本；只给 ``name`` 按注册顺序审计该名称的各版本；
        只给 ``version`` 审计同版本号的全部 Schema；同时给出时审计指定版本，
        无匹配版本抛 :class:`NotFoundError`。文档内 ``#/`` 引用不在审计范围。

        返回普通 dict（可直接 JSON 序列化），含 ``checked``、``total``、
        ``resolved``、``issues``、``references``；审计不改动注册内容、
        不写入检索索引，相同输入返回相同结果。
        """
        return copy.deepcopy(audit_mod.check_references(self._registry, name, version))

    # ======================================================== 字段级变更识别
    def compare_schemas(
        self,
        name: str,
        baseline_version: str,
        candidate: Any = None,
        *,
        candidate_version: str | None = None,
        renames: list[dict[str, str]] | list[list[str]] | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """比较基线版本与候选文档，生成并入库可检索的字段级变更报告。

        ``candidate`` 直接给出候选 JSON Schema 文档；或省略它、仅传
        ``candidate_version`` 以引用同 Schema 标识下已注册的候选版本。
        ``renames`` 为 ``[{"from": 旧路径, "to": 新路径}, ...]``。

        任何不合法情形统一抛 :class:`SchemaComparisonInvalid`。
        相同输入返回相同报告（幂等，不会重复入库）。
        """
        # 1) 解析候选文档与基线版本。
        candidate_document, label = self._resolve_comparison_inputs(
            name, baseline_version, candidate, candidate_version
        )

        # 2) 生成报告（重命名校验在其中完成）。
        report = compare_mod.build_report(
            self._registry,
            name,
            baseline_version,
            candidate_document,
            label,
            renames,
        )

        # 3) 幂等入库并进入全文检索范围。
        report_id = report["report_id"]
        if report_id not in self._reports:
            self._reports[report_id] = report
        if report_id not in self._indexed_reports:
            for i, change in enumerate(report["changes"]):
                self._index_change(report, change, i)
            self._indexed_reports.add(report_id)
        return copy.deepcopy(report)

    def _resolve_comparison_inputs(
        self,
        name: str,
        baseline_version: str,
        candidate: Any,
        candidate_version: str | None,
    ) -> tuple[Any, str | None]:
        """解析并校验比较输入：候选文档（深拷贝）与候选版本标签、基线版本存在性。

        校验口径与 :meth:`compare_schemas` 完全一致，失败时抛
        :class:`SchemaComparisonInvalid`。
        """
        if candidate is None:
            if candidate_version is None:
                raise SchemaComparisonInvalid(
                    "必须提供候选文档 candidate 或已注册的 candidate_version",
                    details={"reason": "candidate_missing"},
                )
            try:
                candidate_record = self._registry.get_schema(name, candidate_version)
            except NotFoundError as exc:
                raise SchemaComparisonInvalid(
                    f"指定版本 {name}@{candidate_version} 不存在",
                    details={"reason": "version_not_found", **exc.details},
                ) from exc
            candidate_document = copy.deepcopy(candidate_record.document)
            label = candidate_version
        else:
            validate_schema(candidate)
            candidate_document = copy.deepcopy(candidate)
            label = candidate_version  # 允许调用方给候选文档附带版本标签

        if not self._registry.has_schema(name, baseline_version):
            raise SchemaComparisonInvalid(
                f"指定版本 {name}@{baseline_version} 不存在",
                details={"reason": "version_not_found", "schema": name, "version": baseline_version},
            )
        return candidate_document, label

    # ============================================================ 升级影响汇总
    def analyze_upgrade_impact(
        self,
        name: str,
        baseline_version: str,
        candidate: Any = None,
        *,
        candidate_version: str | None = None,
        renames: list[dict[str, str]] | list[list[str]] | None = None,
        asset_ids: list[str] | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """汇总一次升级对目录资产的影响（按资产维度的字段级变更视图）。

        候选文档、候选版本、重命名映射与字段路径语义与
        :meth:`compare_schemas` 一致；``report_id`` 与相同输入的
        ``compare_schemas`` 相同。

        ``asset_ids`` 为 ``None`` 时覆盖全部资产；指定时去重且不考虑顺序，
        只覆盖所列资产，未知资产抛 :class:`NotFoundError`。

        本调用为只读操作：不注册候选文档、不生成/改动变更报告、不写入检索
        索引；既有的读取、比较、影响分析与检索行为保持不变。
        """
        candidate_document, label = self._resolve_comparison_inputs(
            name, baseline_version, candidate, candidate_version
        )
        summary = upgrade_mod.build_upgrade_report(
            self._registry,
            name,
            baseline_version,
            candidate_document,
            label,
            renames,
            asset_ids,
        )
        return copy.deepcopy(summary)

    def get_report(self, report_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        if report_id not in self._reports:
            raise NotFoundError(
                f"变更报告 {report_id} 不存在", details={"report_id": report_id}
            )
        return copy.deepcopy(self._reports[report_id])

    def list_reports(
        self, name: str | None = None, version: str | None = None
    ) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        """列出报告摘要（可按 Schema 名称与版本过滤，版本匹配基线或候选）。"""
        out = []
        for rid in sorted(self._reports):
            r = self._reports[rid]
            if name is not None and r["schema"] != name:
                continue
            if version is not None and version not in (
                r["baseline_version"],
                r["candidate_version"],
            ):
                continue
            out.append(
                {
                    "report_id": r["report_id"],
                    "schema": r["schema"],
                    "baseline_version": r["baseline_version"],
                    "candidate_version": r["candidate_version"],
                    "summary": r["summary"],
                }
            )
        return out

    # ================================================================== 检索
    def search(self, keyword: str | None = None, **filters: Any) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        """组合检索 Schema / 资产 / 字段变更。

        可选过滤：``schema``、``version``、``field_path``、``change_kind``、
        ``compatibility``、``asset_name``、``doc_type``、``limit``。
        返回命中条目（含命中字段与命中资产摘要），排序稳定，与插入顺序无关。
        """
        return self._index.search(keyword, **filters)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ 索引维护
    def _index_schema(self, name: str, version: str, document: Any, title: str | None) -> None:
        fields = sf.expand(document)
        root = fields.get("")
        description = ""
        if root is not None:
            d = root.schema.get("description")
            description = d if isinstance(d, str) else ""
        text_fields = {
            "name": name,
            "version": version,
            "title": title or "",
            "description": description,
            "field_paths": "\n".join(sorted(fields)),
        }
        payload = {
            "name": name,
            "version": version,
            "title": title,
            "summary": {
                "name": name,
                "version": version,
                "title": title,
                "field_count": len(fields),
            },
        }
        self._index.add_doc(
            "schema", ("schema", name, version), text_fields, payload
        )

    def _index_asset(self, asset_id: str, name: str, kind: str, refs: list[FieldRef]) -> None:
        schemas = sorted({r.schema for r in refs})
        versions = sorted({f"{r.schema}@{r.version}" for r in refs})
        text_fields = {
            "id": asset_id,
            "name": name,
            "kind": kind,
            "refs": "\n".join(f"{r.schema}@{r.version}{r.path}" for r in refs),
        }
        payload = {
            "id": asset_id,
            "name": name,
            "kind": kind,
            "schemas": schemas,
            "versions": versions,
            "summary": {
                "asset_id": asset_id,
                "name": name,
                "kind": kind,
                "ref_count": len(refs),
            },
        }
        self._index.add_doc("asset", ("asset", asset_id), text_fields, payload)

    def _index_change(self, report: dict[str, Any], change: dict[str, Any], seq: int) -> None:
        direct = change["direct_assets"]
        transitive = change["transitive_assets"]
        impacted: dict[str, str] = {}
        for a in direct:
            impacted[a["asset_id"]] = a["name"]
        for a in transitive:
            impacted.setdefault(a["asset_id"], a["name"])

        asset_text = "\n".join(sorted(impacted.values()))
        asset_id_text = "\n".join(sorted(impacted))
        summary_text = _summary_text(change["old_summary"]) + "\n" + _summary_text(
            change["new_summary"]
        )
        text_fields = {
            "schema": report["schema"],
            "version": " ".join(
                v for v in (report["baseline_version"], report["candidate_version"]) if v
            ),
            "field_path": "\n".join(
                p for p in (change["old_path"], change["new_path"], change["path"]) if p
            ),
            "change_kind": change["change_kind"],
            "compatibility": change["compatibility"],
            "impact_assets": asset_text,
            "impact_asset_ids": asset_id_text,
            "summary": summary_text,
        }
        key = (
            "change",
            report["schema"],
            report["baseline_version"],
            report["candidate_version"] or "",
            report["report_id"],
            change["path"],
            change["old_path"] or "",
            change["change_kind"],
            seq,
        )
        payload = {
            "report_id": report["report_id"],
            "schema": report["schema"],
            "baseline_version": report["baseline_version"],
            "candidate_version": report["candidate_version"],
            "path": change["path"],
            "old_path": change["old_path"],
            "new_path": change["new_path"],
            "change_kind": change["change_kind"],
            "compatibility": change["compatibility"],
            "old_summary": change["old_summary"],
            "new_summary": change["new_summary"],
            "matched_assets": [
                {"asset_id": aid, "name": impacted[aid]} for aid in sorted(impacted)
            ],
            "direct_assets": direct,
            "transitive_assets": transitive,
            "summary": {
                "report_id": report["report_id"],
                "schema": report["schema"],
                "path": change["path"],
                "change_kind": change["change_kind"],
                "compatibility": change["compatibility"],
                "assets": [
                    {"asset_id": aid, "name": impacted[aid]} for aid in sorted(impacted)
                ],
            },
        }
        self._index.add_doc("change", key, text_fields, payload)


def _summary_text(summary: dict[str, Any] | None) -> str:
    if not summary:
        return ""
    parts: list[str] = []
    for key, value in summary.items():
        parts.append(f"{key}={_flatten(value)}")
    return "\n".join(parts)


def _flatten(value: Any) -> str:
    if isinstance(value, (dict, list)):
        import json

        return json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True)
    return str(value)

"""错误类型与公开错误码。"""


class CatalogError(Exception):
    """所有目录服务错误的基类。

    :ivar code: 稳定的公开错误码字符串。
    """

    code = "CatalogError"

    def __init__(self, message, *, details=None):
        super().__init__(message)
        self.message = message
        self.details = details or {}


class NotFoundError(CatalogError):
    """指定的 Schema、版本、资产或报告不存在。"""

    code = "NotFound"


class AlreadyExistsError(CatalogError):
    """同名资源已注册（注册内容不可变，不支持覆盖）。"""

    code = "AlreadyExists"


class SchemaComparisonInvalid(CatalogError):
    """字段级比较请求不合法。

    覆盖以下情形：候选文档不是合法 JSON Schema、指定版本不存在、
    重命名起点或终点不存在、同一路径被重复映射、重命名映射跨版本不一致。
    """

    code = "SchemaComparisonInvalid"


class ImpactAnalysisTooLarge(CatalogError):
    """分析对象数量或影响链长度/数量超过公开限制。"""

    code = "ImpactAnalysisTooLarge"

7	例如 ``"Address@1.0#/properties/street"``；``#`` 后为空表示引用文档根。

13	import copy
14	import re

18	from .errors import AlreadyExistsError, NotFoundError

22	_REF_RE = re.compile(r"^(?P<name>[^@#/\s]+)@(?P<version>[^@#\s]+)#(?P<pointer>.*)$")
23	_NAME_RE = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z0-9_.\-]+$")

26	def validate_name(name: str, *, what: str = "名称") -> None:
27	    if not isinstance(name, str) or not name or not _NAME_RE.match(name):
28	        raise ValueError(f"非法{what}: {name!r}（只允许字母、数字、_、.、-）")

30	
31	@dataclass(frozen=True)
32	class SchemaVersion:
33	    name: str
34	    version: str
35	    document: Any
36	    title: str | None
37	
38

40	class FieldRef:
41	    """资产对某 Schema 某版本某字段路径的直接引用。"""
42	
43	    schema: str
44	    version: str
45	    path: str  # JSON Pointer，"" 表示根

48	@dataclass(frozen=True)
49	class Asset:
50	    id: str
51	    name: str
52	    kind: str
53	    refs: tuple[FieldRef, ...]
54	
55	
56	@dataclass(frozen=True)
57	class RefEdge:
58	    """一条跨 Schema ``$ref`` 边：src 字段定义引用了 dst 字段节点。"""
59	
60	    src_schema: str
61	    src_version: str
62	    src_path: str
63	    dst_schema: str
64	    dst_version: str
65	    dst_path: str
66

68	def parse_external_ref(ref: str) -> tuple[str, str, str] | None:
69	    """解析跨 Schema 引用；非此外部形式返回 ``None``。"""
70	    m = _REF_RE.match(ref)
71	    if not m:
72	        return None
73	    return m.group("name"), m.group("version"), m.group("pointer")

76	def extract_ref_edges(name: str, version: str, document: Any) -> list[RefEdge]:
77	    """提取文档内全部跨 Schema 引用边（原始文档指针，按出现顺序排序）。
78	
79	    指针在注册时再结合两端文档解析为逻辑字段路径。
80	    """
81	    edges: list[RefEdge] = []
82	
83	    def walk(node: Any, path: str, seen: frozenset[int]) -> None:
84	        if isinstance(node, bool) or not isinstance(node, (dict, list)):
85	            return
86	        if id(node) in seen:
87	            return
88	        seen = seen | {id(node)}
89	        if isinstance(node, dict):
90	            ref = node.get("$ref")
91	            if isinstance(ref, str):
92	                parsed = parse_external_ref(ref)
93	                if parsed is not None:
94	                    dst_name, dst_version, fragment = parsed
95	                    if fragment and not fragment.startswith("/"):
96	                        fragment = "/" + fragment
97	                    edges.append(
98	                        RefEdge(name, version, path, dst_name, dst_version, fragment)
99	                    )
100	            for k in sorted(node.keys()):
101	                walk(node[k], path + "/" + _escape(k) if path else "/" + _escape(k), seen)
102	        else:
103	            for i, v in enumerate(node):
104	                walk(v, f"{path}/{i}" if path else f"/{i}", seen)
105	
106	    walk(document, "", frozenset())
107	    edges.sort(key=lambda e: (e.src_path, e.dst_schema, e.dst_version, e.dst_path))
108	    return edges
109	
110	
111	def _escape(token: str) -> str:
112	    return token.replace("~", "~0").replace("/", "~1")
113

115	class Registry:
116	    def __init__(self) -> None:
117	        self._schemas: dict[tuple[str, str], SchemaVersion] = {}
118	        # name -> 按注册顺序保存的版本列表
119	        self._versions: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
120	        self._assets: dict[str, Asset] = {}
121	        self._edges: dict[tuple[str, str], tuple[RefEdge, ...]] = {}
122	
123	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ schema
124	    def register_schema(self, name: str, version: str, document: Any) -> SchemaVersion:
125	        validate_name(name, what="Schema 名称")
126	        validate_name(version, what="版本号")
127	        key = (name, version)
128	        if key in self._schemas:
129	            raise AlreadyExistsError(
130	                f"Schema {name}@{version} 已注册，注册内容不可覆盖",
131	                details={"schema": name, "version": version},
132	            )
133	        # 跨 Schema 引用允许前向（目标稍后注册），因此引用环也可注册；
134	        # 目标缺失或目标字段不存在时，影响传播自然不会产生命中。
135	        raw_edges = extract_ref_edges(name, version, document)
136	        edges: list[RefEdge] = []
137	        for e in raw_edges:
138	            dst_record = self._schemas.get((e.dst_schema, e.dst_version))
139	            dst_raw = e.dst_path if e.dst_path else ""
140	            if dst_record is not None:

142	                if dst_logical is None or dst_logical not in _expand_fields(dst_record.document):
143	                    # 目标已注册但字段不存在：属于确定的非法引用。
144	                    raise NotFoundError(

146	                        details={

148	                            "version": e.dst_version,
149	                            "path": dst_raw,
150	                        },
151	                    )
152	                final_dst = dst_logical
153	            else:
154	                final_dst = ptr.normalize_field_pointer(dst_raw)
155	            src_logical = ptr.resolve_logical(document, e.src_path)
156	            edges.append(
157	                RefEdge(
158	                    name,
159	                    version,
160	                    src_logical or ptr.normalize_field_pointer(e.src_path),
161	                    e.dst_schema,
162	                    e.dst_version,
163	                    final_dst,
164	                )
165	            )
166	        edges.sort(key=lambda x: (x.src_path, x.dst_schema, x.dst_version, x.dst_path))
167	        title = None
168	        if isinstance(document, dict):
169	            t = document.get("title")
170	            title = t if isinstance(t, str) else None
171	        record = SchemaVersion(name, version, copy.deepcopy(document), title)
172	        self._schemas[key] = record
173	        self._versions.setdefault(name, []).append(version)
174	        self._edges[key] = tuple(edges)
175	        return record
176	
177	    def get_schema(self, name: str, version: str) -> SchemaVersion:
178	        key = (name, version)
179	        if key not in self._schemas:
180	            raise NotFoundError(
181	                f"Schema {name}@{version} 不存在",
182	                details={"schema": name, "version": version},
183	            )
184	        return self._schemas[key]
185	
186	    def has_schema(self, name: str, version: str) -> bool:
187	        return (name, version) in self._schemas
188	
189	    def schema_document(self, name: str, version: str) -> Any:
190	        return copy.deepcopy(self.get_schema(name, version).document)
191	
192	    def list_versions(self, name: str) -> list[str]:
193	        if name not in self._versions:
194	            raise NotFoundError(f"Schema {name} 不存在", details={"schema": name})
195	        return list(self._versions[name])
196	
197	    def edges(self, name: str, version: str) -> tuple[RefEdge, ...]:
198	        return self._edges.get((name, version), ())
199	
200	    def all_edges(self) -> list[RefEdge]:
201	        out: list[RefEdge] = []
202	        for key in sorted(self._edges):
203	            out.extend(self._edges[key])
204	        return out
205	
206	    def all_schemas(self) -> list[SchemaVersion]:
207	        return [self._schemas[k] for k in sorted(self._schemas)]
208	
209	    def registered_pairs(self) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
210	        """按全局注册顺序返回全部 ``(名称, 版本)``。"""
211	        return list(self._schemas.keys())
212	
213	    def logical_path_exists(self, schema: str, version: str, path: str) -> bool:
214	        """判断逻辑字段路径是否可达（含沿跨 Schema ``$ref`` 跳转解析）。"""
215	        return self._logical_path_exists(
216	            schema, version, path, frozenset({(schema, version)})
217	        )
218	
219	    def _logical_path_exists(
220	        self, schema: str, version: str, path: str, stack: frozenset[tuple[str, str]]
221	    ) -> bool:
222	        """判断逻辑字段路径是否可达，沿跨 Schema ``$ref`` 边跳转解析。"""
223	        if (schema, version) not in self._schemas:
224	            return False
225	        document = self._schemas[(schema, version)].document
226	        valid_paths = _expand_fields(document)
227	        if path in valid_paths:
228	            return True
229	
230	        target_segs = ptr.parse(path)
231	        # 选择最长的、能覆盖目标路径前缀的出边。
232	        best = None
233	        for edge in self._edges.get((schema, version), ()):  # type: RefEdge
234	            esegs = ptr.parse(edge.src_path)
235	            if len(esegs) <= len(target_segs) and target_segs[: len(esegs)] == esegs:
236	                if best is None or len(esegs) > len(ptr.parse(best.src_path)):
237	                    best = edge
238	        if best is None:
239	            return False
240	        dst_key = (best.dst_schema, best.dst_version)
241	        if dst_key in stack:
242	            return False
243	        suffix = target_segs[len(ptr.parse(best.src_path)) :]
244	        resolved = ptr.format(list(ptr.parse(best.dst_path)) + list(suffix))
245	        return self._logical_path_exists(
246	            best.dst_schema, best.dst_version, resolved, stack | {dst_key}
247	        )
248	
249	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------- asset
250	    def register_asset(
251	        self,
252	        asset_id: str,
253	        name: str,
254	        kind: str,
255	        refs: list[FieldRef] | list[dict] | None = None,
256	    ) -> Asset:
257	        validate_name(asset_id, what="资产标识")
258	        if not isinstance(name, str) or not name:
259	            raise ValueError("资产名称必须是非空字符串")
260	        if not isinstance(kind, str) or not kind:
261	            raise ValueError("资产类型必须是非空字符串")
262	        if asset_id in self._assets:
263	            raise AlreadyExistsError(
264	                f"资产 {asset_id} 已注册", details={"asset": asset_id}
265	            )
266	
267	        normalized: list[FieldRef] = []
268	        seen: set[tuple[str, str, str]] = set()
269	        for raw in refs or []:
270	            if isinstance(raw, FieldRef):
271	                r = raw
272	            else:
273	                r = FieldRef(raw["schema"], str(raw["version"]), raw.get("path", ""))
274	            validate_name(r.schema, what="引用 Schema 名称")
275	            record = self.get_schema(r.schema, r.version)
276	            if r.path and not r.path.startswith("/"):
277	                raise ValueError(f"资产引用字段路径必须是 JSON Pointer: {r.path!r}")
278	            candidate_paths = []
279	            contextual = ptr.resolve_logical(record.document, r.path)
280	            if contextual is not None:
281	                candidate_paths.append(contextual)
282	            text_normalized = ptr.normalize_field_pointer(r.path)
283	            for cand in (text_normalized, r.path):
284	                if cand not in candidate_paths:
285	                    candidate_paths.append(cand)
286	
287	            resolved_path = next(
288	                (
289	                    cand
290	                    for cand in candidate_paths
291	                    if self._logical_path_exists(
292	                        r.schema, r.version, cand, frozenset({(r.schema, r.version)})
293	                    )
294	                ),
295	                None,
296	            )
297	            if resolved_path is None:
298	                raise NotFoundError(
299	                    f"资产引用的字段 {r.schema}@{r.version}{text_normalized} 不存在",
300	                    details={
301	                        "schema": r.schema,
302	                        "version": r.version,
303	                        "path": text_normalized,
304	                    },
305	                )
306	            r = FieldRef(r.schema, r.version, resolved_path)
307	            dedup_key = (r.schema, r.version, r.path)
308	            if dedup_key in seen:
309	                continue
310	            seen.add(dedup_key)
311	            normalized.append(r)
312	
313	        normalized.sort(key=lambda r: (r.schema, r.version, r.path))
314	        asset = Asset(asset_id, name, kind, tuple(normalized))
315	        self._assets[asset_id] = asset
316	        return asset
317	
318	    def get_asset(self, asset_id: str) -> Asset:
319	        if asset_id not in self._assets:
320	            raise NotFoundError(f"资产 {asset_id} 不存在", details={"asset": asset_id})
321	        return self._assets[asset_id]
322	
323	    def all_assets(self) -> list[Asset]:
324	        return [self._assets[k] for k in sorted(self._assets)]

2	
3	输入两个同一 Schema 标识下的 JSON Schema 文档（基线版本、候选版本）与显式
4	字段重命名映射，产出确定性的字段级变更报告。

8	  * ``deleted``          删除字段（破坏）

13	  * ``metadata``         仅标题/描述/注释变化（元数据变更）

19

71	    for i, item in enumerate(renames):
72	        if isinstance(item, dict):
73	            src, dst = item.get("from"), item.get("to")
74	        elif isinstance(item, (tuple, list)) and len(item) == 2:
75	            src, dst = item[0], item[1]
76	        else:
77	            src = dst = None
78	        if not isinstance(src, str) or not isinstance(dst, str) or not src or not dst:
79	            raise SchemaComparisonInvalid(
80	                f"第 {i} 条重命名映射必须包含非空字符串 from 与 to",
81	                details={"reason": "rename_invalid", "index": i},
82	            )
83	        pairs.append((src, dst))
84	
85	    # 1) 起点/终点必须存在于对应版本。
86	    for src, dst in pairs:
87	        if src not in old_fields:
88	            raise SchemaComparisonInvalid(
89	                f"重命名起点 {src} 在基线版本中不存在",
90	                details={"reason": "rename_from_not_found", "path": src},
91	            )
92	        if dst not in new_fields:
93	            raise SchemaComparisonInvalid(
94	                f"重命名终点 {dst} 在候选版本中不存在",
95	                details={"reason": "rename_to_not_found", "path": dst},
96	            )
97	
98	    # 2) 同一路径不得被重复映射（任一端点出现两次，或起点等于终点）。
99	    seen: set[str] = set()
100	    for src, dst in pairs:
101	        for ep in (src, dst):
102	            if ep in seen:
103	                raise SchemaComparisonInvalid(
104	                    f"路径 {ep} 在重命名映射中被重复使用",
105	                    details={"reason": "rename_duplicate", "path": ep},
106	                )
107	            seen.add(ep)
108	
109	    # 端点两两之间子树不得重叠，否则同一路径被隐式映射两次。
110	    ordered = sorted(seen, key=lambda p: ptr.parse(p))
111	    for a, b in zip(ordered, ordered[1:]):
112	        if ptr.is_under(a, b):
113	            raise SchemaComparisonInvalid(
114	                f"重命名端点 {a} 与 {b} 的子树重叠，映射不明确",
115	                details={"reason": "rename_overlapping", "paths": [a, b]},
116	            )
117	
118	    # 3) 跨版本一致性：起点不应仍在候选版本、终点不应已在基线版本。
119	    for src, dst in pairs:
120	        if src in new_fields:
121	            raise SchemaComparisonInvalid(
122	                f"重命名起点 {src} 仍存在于候选版本，映射跨版本不一致",
123	                details={"reason": "rename_cross_version_inconsistent", "path": src},
124	            )
125	        if dst in old_fields:
126	            raise SchemaComparisonInvalid(
127	                f"重命名终点 {dst} 已存在于基线版本，映射跨版本不一致",
128	                details={"reason": "rename_cross_version_inconsistent", "path": dst},
129	            )
130	
131	    return pairs
132	
133	
134	def _entry(
135	    change_kind: str,
136	    compatibility: str,
137	    old_path: str | None,
138	    new_path: str | None,
139	    old_schema: dict | None,
140	    new_schema: dict | None,
141	    impacts: dict | None,
142	) -> dict[str, Any]:
143	    return {
144	        "path": new_path if new_path is not None else old_path,
145	        "old_path": old_path,
146	        "new_path": new_path,
147	        "old_summary": _summary(old_schema) if old_schema is not None else None,
148	        "new_summary": _summary(new_schema) if new_schema is not None else None,
149	        "change_kind": change_kind,
150	        "compatibility": compatibility,
151	        "direct_assets": list(impacts["direct_assets"]) if impacts else [],
152	        "transitive_assets": list(impacts["transitive_assets"]) if impacts else [],
153	    }
154	
155	
156	def _compare_matched(
157	    old_field: sf.Field, new_field: sf.Field, old_required: bool, new_required: bool
158	) -> tuple[str, str] | None:
159	    """比较两侧对齐的同字段，返回 (change_kind, compatibility) 或 None。"""
160	    old_s, new_s = old_field.schema, new_field.schema
161	    struct_changed = sf.structural_signature(old_s) != sf.structural_signature(new_s)
162	
163	    if not struct_changed:
164	        if old_required == new_required:
165	            annotation_changed = (
166	                sf.annotation_signature(old_s) != sf.annotation_signature(new_s)
167	            )
168	            return (METADATA, METADATA_COMPAT) if annotation_changed else None
169	        if new_required:
170	            return REQUIRED_ADDED, BREAKING
171	        return REQUIRED_REMOVED, COMPATIBLE
172	
173	    verdict = sf.classify_pair(old_s, new_s)
174	    if new_required and not old_required:
175	        verdict = BREAKING  # 结构变化与新增必填同时发生，取更严格结论
176	    return MODIFIED, verdict
177	
178	
179	def build_report(
180	    registry: Registry,
181	    name: str,
182	    baseline_version: str,
183	    candidate_document: Any,
184	    candidate_version: str | None,
185	    renames: list | None,
186	) -> dict[str, Any]:
187	    """构造字段级变更报告（不读取候选注册内容、不改动任何注册数据）。"""
188	    from .impact import analyze_field
189	
190	    old_doc = registry.get_schema(name, baseline_version).document
191	
192	    old_fields = sf.expand(old_doc)
193	    new_fields = sf.expand(candidate_document)
194	    if len(old_fields) > limits.MAX_FIELDS or len(new_fields) > limits.MAX_FIELDS:
195	        raise ImpactAnalysisTooLarge(
196	            "分析对象字段数量超过公开限制",
197	            details={
198	                "reason": "fields_exceeded",
199	                "limit": limits.MAX_FIELDS,
200	                "baseline_fields": len(old_fields),
201	                "candidate_fields": len(new_fields),
202	            },
203	        )
204	    old_required = _required_set(old_fields)
205	    new_required = _required_set(new_fields)
206	
207	    pairs = validate_renames(renames, old_fields, new_fields)
208	    rename_srcs = dict(pairs)
209	    rename_dsts = {d: s for s, d in pairs}
210	
211	    def in_rename_subtree(path: str, roots: dict[str, str]) -> str | None:
212	        """返回包含该路径的重命名根（路径按段序排序，最近的根唯一）。"""
213	        segs = ptr.parse(path)
214	        best = None
215	        for root in roots:
216	            rsegs = ptr.parse(root)
217	            if len(rsegs) <= len(segs) and segs[: len(rsegs)] == rsegs:
218	                if best is None or len(rsegs) > len(ptr.parse(best)):
219	                    best = root
220	        return best
221	
222	    # 重命名子树对齐：old 后缀路径 -> new 后缀路径（仅当两侧都存在）。
223	    aligned_old: dict[str, str] = {}
224	    aligned_new: dict[str, str] = {}
225	    for src, dst in pairs:
226	        src_segs, dst_segs = ptr.parse(src), ptr.parse(dst)
227	        for p in old_fields:
228	            psegs = ptr.parse(p)
229	            if len(psegs) <= len(src_segs) or psegs[: len(src_segs)] != src_segs:
230	                continue
231	            q = ptr.format(dst_segs + psegs[len(src_segs) :])
232	            if q in new_fields:
233	                aligned_old[p] = q
234	                aligned_new[q] = p
235	
236	    changes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
237	
238	    def impacts_for(old_path: str) -> dict:
239	        return analyze_field(registry, name, baseline_version, old_path)
240	
241	    # 1) 重命名根：每条映射恰好一条 rename（不再计删除+新增）。
242	    for src, dst in sorted(pairs):
243	        changes.append(
244	            _entry(
245	                RENAMED,
246	                BREAKING,
247	                src,
248	                dst,
249	                old_fields[src].schema,
250	                new_fields[dst].schema,
251	                impacts_for(src),
252	            )
253	        )
254	
255	    # 2) 旧侧：子树对齐字段做配对比较；其余旧侧独有路径为 deleted。
256	    for p in sorted(old_fields, key=lambda x: ptr.parse(x)):
257	        if p in rename_srcs:
258	            continue
259	        if in_rename_subtree(p, rename_srcs) is not None:
260	            q = aligned_old.get(p)
261	            if q is None:
262	                changes.append(
263	                    _entry(
264	                        DELETED, BREAKING, p, None,
265	                        old_fields[p].schema, None, impacts_for(p),
266	                    )
267	                )
268	            else:
269	                decision = _compare_matched(
270	                    old_fields[p], new_fields[q], p in old_required, q in new_required
271	                )
272	                if decision is not None:
273	                    changes.append(
274	                        _entry(
275	                            decision[0], decision[1], p, q,
276	                            old_fields[p].schema, new_fields[q].schema,
277	                            impacts_for(p),
278	                        )
279	                    )
280	            continue
281	        if p in new_fields:
282	            continue  # 公共路径，第 4 步处理
283	        changes.append(
284	            _entry(
285	                DELETED, BREAKING, p, None,
286	                old_fields[p].schema, None, impacts_for(p),
287	            )
288	        )
289	
290	    # 3) 新侧：重命名子树中未覆盖的新路径与其余新侧独有路径为 added。
291	    for q in sorted(new_fields, key=lambda x: ptr.parse(x)):
292	        if q in rename_dsts:
293	            continue
294	        if in_rename_subtree(q, rename_dsts) is not None:
295	            if q in aligned_new:
296	                continue  # 已在第 2 步配对比较
297	        elif q in old_fields:
298	            continue  # 公共路径，第 4 步处理
299	        changes.append(
300	            _entry(
301	                ADDED,
302	                BREAKING if q in new_required else COMPATIBLE,
303	                None,
304	                q,
305	                None,
306	                new_fields[q].schema,
307	                None,
308	            )
309	        )
310	
311	    # 4) 非重命名公共路径。
312	    for p in sorted(old_fields, key=lambda x: ptr.parse(x)):
313	        if p in rename_srcs or in_rename_subtree(p, rename_srcs) is not None:
314	            continue
315	        if p not in new_fields:
316	            continue
317	        decision = _compare_matched(
318	            old_fields[p], new_fields[p], p in old_required, p in new_required
319	        )
320	        if decision is not None:
321	            changes.append(
322	                _entry(
323	                    decision[0], decision[1], p, p,
324	                    old_fields[p].schema, new_fields[p].schema, impacts_for(p),
325	                )
326	            )
327	
328	    if len(changes) > limits.MAX_CHANGES:
329	        raise ImpactAnalysisTooLarge(
330	            "变更条目数量超过公开限制",
331	            details={"reason": "changes_exceeded", "limit": limits.MAX_CHANGES},
332	        )
333	
334	    # 确定性排序：按展示路径段、路径文本、变更种类。
335	    changes.sort(
336	        key=lambda e: (
337	            ptr.parse(e["path"]),
338	            e["path"],
339	            e["change_kind"],
340	            e["old_path"] or "",
341	        )
342	    )
343	
344	    counts = {BREAKING: 0, COMPATIBLE: 0, METADATA_COMPAT: 0}
345	    for e in changes:
346	        counts[e["compatibility"]] += 1
347	
348	    canonical = json.dumps(
349	        {
350	            "schema": name,
351	            "baseline_version": baseline_version,
352	            "candidate_version": candidate_version,
353	            "candidate_document": candidate_document,
354	            "renames": sorted(pairs),
355	        },
356	        sort_keys=True,
357	        ensure_ascii=False,
358	        separators=(",", ":"),
359	    )
360	    report_id = hashlib.sha256(canonical.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:16]
361	
362	    return {
363	        "report_id": report_id,
364	        "schema": name,
365	        "baseline_version": baseline_version,
366	        "candidate_version": candidate_version,
367	        "renames": [{"from": s, "to": d} for s, d in sorted(pairs)],
368	        "summary": {
369	            "total": len(changes),
370	            "breaking": counts[BREAKING],
371	            "compatible": counts[COMPATIBLE],
372	            "metadata": counts[METADATA_COMPAT],
373	        },
374	        "changes": changes,
375	    }

1	"""字段级影响分析。
2	
3	直接影响：资产的字段引用与目标字段 ``(schema, version, path)`` 精确相等。
4	传递影响：从资产引用的具体字段出发，沿跨 Schema ``$ref`` 边正向解析，
5	若能到达目标字段（精确相等、或祖先/后代包含关系），即构成传递命中。
6	
7	正向解析从资产引用的 *具体* 路径出发，路径长度随跨边跳数只减不增，因此
8	即使 Schema 之间存在根级引用环，状态空间也是有限的。传递结果按稳定标识
9	``(资产, schema, version, 引用路径)`` 去重。
10	"""
11	
12	from __future__ import annotations
13	
14	from dataclasses import dataclass
15	
16	from . import limits, pointer as ptr
17	from .errors import ImpactAnalysisTooLarge
18	from .registry import Registry, RefEdge
19	
20	
21	@dataclass(frozen=True)
22	class Reach:
23	    schema: str
24	    version: str
25	    path: str
26	
27	
28	def _related(a: str, b: str) -> bool:
29	    return a == b or ptr.is_under(a, b) or ptr.is_under(b, a)
30	
31	
32	def _build_outgoing(registry: Registry) -> dict[tuple[str, str], list[RefEdge]]:
33	    outgoing: dict[tuple[str, str], list[RefEdge]] = {}
34	    for edge in registry.all_edges():
35	        outgoing.setdefault((edge.src_schema, edge.src_version), []).append(edge)
36	    for edges in outgoing.values():
37	        edges.sort(
38	            key=lambda e: (e.dst_schema, e.dst_version, e.src_path, e.dst_path)
39	        )
40	    return outgoing
41	
42	
43	def forward_reach(
44	    registry: Registry,
45	    schema: str,
46	    version: str,
47	    path: str,
48	    outgoing: dict[tuple[str, str], list[RefEdge]] | None = None,
49	    cache: dict[tuple[str, str, str], list[Reach]] | None = None,
50	) -> list[Reach]:
51	    """从一个具体字段出发正向解析跨 Schema 引用，返回可到达的全部字段。
52	
53	    每条出边满足：边的源路径与当前路径相等，或是当前路径的祖先
54	    （引用了包含当前字段的子树）；目标侧路径按后缀对齐。
55	    """
56	    if cache is not None:
57	        cached = cache.get((schema, version, path))
58	        if cached is not None:
59	            return cached
60	    if outgoing is None:
61	        outgoing = _build_outgoing(registry)
62	
63	    start = Reach(schema, version, path)
64	    reached: dict[Reach, None] = {start: None}
65	    queue: list[tuple[Reach, int]] = [(start, 0)]
66	    edges_walked = 0
67	
68	    while queue:
69	        state, depth = queue.pop(0)
70	        if depth >= limits.MAX_IMPACT_DEPTH:
71	            raise ImpactAnalysisTooLarge(
72	                "影响链深度超过公开限制",
73	                details={
74	                    "reason": "depth_exceeded",
75	                    "limit": limits.MAX_IMPACT_DEPTH,
76	                    "schema": state.schema,
77	                    "version": state.version,
78	                    "path": state.path,
79	                },
80	            )
81	        for edge in outgoing.get((state.schema, state.version), ()):
82	            sp, cp = ptr.parse(edge.src_path), ptr.parse(state.path)
83	            if not (len(sp) <= len(cp) and cp[: len(sp)] == sp):
84	                continue
85	            edges_walked += 1
86	            if edges_walked > limits.MAX_IMPACT_VISITED:
87	                raise ImpactAnalysisTooLarge(
88	                    "影响链引用边数量超过公开限制",
89	                    details={"reason": "edges_exceeded", "limit": limits.MAX_IMPACT_VISITED},
90	                )
91	            suffix = cp[len(sp) :]
92	            mapped = Reach(
93	                edge.dst_schema,
94	                edge.dst_version,
95	                ptr.format(list(ptr.parse(edge.dst_path)) + list(suffix)),
96	            )
97	            if mapped in reached:
98	                continue
99	            reached[mapped] = None
100	            queue.append((mapped, depth + 1))
101	
102	    del reached[start]
103	    result = sorted(reached.keys(), key=lambda r: (r.schema, r.version, r.path))
104	    if cache is not None:
105	        cache[(schema, version, path)] = result
106	    return result
107	
108	
109	def analyze_field(registry: Registry, schema: str, version: str, path: str) -> dict:
110	    """返回单个字段的影响资产：直接 + 传递（各自稳定排序、去重）。"""
111	    registry.get_schema(schema, version)
112	
113	    direct: dict[str, dict] = {}
114	    transitive_map: dict[tuple[str, str, str, str], dict] = {}
115	    outgoing = _build_outgoing(registry)
116	    reach_cache: dict[tuple[str, str, str], list[Reach]] = {}
117	
118	    for asset in registry.all_assets():
119	        for ref in asset.refs:
120	            if ref.schema == schema and ref.version == version:
121	                if ref.path == path:
122	                    direct.setdefault(
123	                        asset.id,
124	                        {"asset_id": asset.id, "name": asset.name, "kind": asset.kind},
125	                    )
126	                    continue
127	
128	            # 传递：从资产引用的具体字段正向解析到目标字段。
129	            reachable = forward_reach(
130	                registry, ref.schema, ref.version, ref.path, outgoing, reach_cache
131	            )
132	            matched = [r for r in reachable if r.schema == schema and r.version == version
133	                       and _related(r.path, path)]
134	            if not matched:
135	                continue
136	            key = (asset.id, ref.schema, ref.version, ref.path)
137	            entry = transitive_map.get(key)
138	            if entry is None:
139	                entry = {
140	                    "asset_id": asset.id,
141	                    "name": asset.name,
142	                    "kind": asset.kind,
143	                    "schema": ref.schema,
144	                    "version": ref.version,
145	                    "path": ref.path,
146	                    "matched_paths": [],
147	                }
148	                transitive_map[key] = entry
149	            for r in matched:
150	                if r.path not in entry["matched_paths"]:
151	                    entry["matched_paths"].append(r.path)
152	
153	    transitive = list(transitive_map.values())
154	    for entry in transitive:
155	        entry["matched_paths"].sort(key=lambda p: (ptr.parse(p), p))
156	
157	    if len(direct) + len(transitive) > limits.MAX_IMPACT_ASSETS:
158	        raise ImpactAnalysisTooLarge(
159	            "影响资产数量超过公开限制",
160	            details={"reason": "assets_exceeded", "limit": limits.MAX_IMPACT_ASSETS},
161	        )
162	
163	    return {
164	        "schema": schema,
165	        "version": version,
166	        "path": path,
167	        "direct_assets": [direct[k] for k in sorted(direct)],
168	        "transitive_assets": sorted(
169	            transitive,
170	            key=lambda a: (a["asset_id"], a["schema"], a["version"], a["path"]),
171	        ),
172	    }

1	"""全文检索。
2	
3	索引三类文档：已注册 Schema、目录资产、字段级变更报告中的每条变更。
4	变更报告生成后自动进入检索范围；新增文档类型不会改变旧查询的结果语义与
5	排序——排序完全由匹配分与确定性键决定，与索引插入顺序无关。
6	
7	分词口径（对普通关键词保持唯一、稳定的匹配口径）：
8	  * 拉丁字母/数字连续串作为一个词条（小写）；
9	  * 中日韩字符连续串按二元组切分（单字保留单字）；
10	  * 同一查询内多个关键词词条之间为 AND。
11	"""
12	
13	from __future__ import annotations
14	
15	import re
16	from dataclasses import dataclass, field
17	from typing import Any
18	
19	_TOKEN_RE = re.compile(r"[0-9a-z_]+|[一-鿿]+", re.IGNORECASE)
20	
21	
22	def tokenize(text: str | None) -> list[str]:
23	    if text is None:
24	        return []
25	    tokens: list[str] = []
26	    for piece in _TOKEN_RE.findall(str(text).lower()):
27	        if "一" <= piece[0] <= "鿿":
28	            if len(piece) == 1:
29	                tokens.append(piece)
30	            else:
31	                tokens.extend(piece[i : i + 2] for i in range(len(piece) - 1))
32	        else:
33	            tokens.append(piece)
34	    return tokens
35	
36	
37	@dataclass
38	class IndexedDoc:
39	    doc_type: str  # "schema" | "asset" | "change"
40	    key: tuple  # 确定性排序键
41	    fields: dict[str, str]  # 命名字段 -> 原文（用于返回“命中字段”）
42	    payload: dict[str, Any]
43	    tokens: dict[str, frozenset[str]] = field(default_factory=dict)
44	
45	
46	class SearchIndex:
47	    def __init__(self) -> None:
48	        self._docs: list[IndexedDoc] = []
49	
50	    def add_doc(
51	        self,
52	        doc_type: str,
53	        key: tuple,
54	        fields: dict[str, str],
55	        payload: dict[str, Any],
56	    ) -> None:
57	        tokens = {
58	            name: frozenset(tokenize(value))
59	            for name, value in fields.items()
60	            if value is not None
61	        }
62	        self._docs.append(IndexedDoc(doc_type, tuple(key), dict(fields), payload, tokens))
63	
64	    def search(
65	        self,
66	        keyword: str | None = None,
67	        *,
68	        doc_type: str | None = None,
69	        schema: str | None = None,
70	        version: str | None = None,
71	        field_path: str | None = None,
72	        change_kind: str | None = None,
73	        compatibility: str | None = None,
74	        asset_name: str | None = None,
75	        limit: int | None = None,
76	    ) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
77	        """组合检索。结构化过滤条件之间为 AND；keyword 在可检索文本字段上 AND
78	        全命中。返回结果按（命中字段数降序、确定性键升序）稳定排序。"""
79	        terms = tokenize(keyword) if keyword else []
80	        asset_terms = tokenize(asset_name) if asset_name else []
81	
82	        results: list[tuple[int, tuple, dict[str, Any]]] = []
83	        for doc in self._docs:
84	            if doc_type is not None and doc.doc_type != doc_type:
85	                continue
86	            p = doc.payload
87	
88	            if not self._passes_filters(
89	                doc, p, schema, version, field_path, change_kind, compatibility, asset_terms
90	            ):
91	                continue
92	
93	            hit_fields: set[str] = set()
94	            for fname, toks in doc.tokens.items():
95	                if terms and all(t in toks for t in terms):
96	                    hit_fields.add(fname)
97	            if terms and not hit_fields:
98	                continue
99	
100	            if asset_terms:
101	                hit_fields |= self._asset_hit_fields(doc, asset_terms)
102	
103	            item = {
104	                "type": doc.doc_type,
105	                "matched_fields": sorted(hit_fields),
106	                **p,
107	            }
108	            results.append((len(hit_fields), doc.key, item))
109	
110	        results.sort(key=lambda r: (-r[0], r[1]))
111	        hits = [r[2] for r in results]
112	        return hits[:limit] if limit is not None else hits
113	
114	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ filters
115	    @staticmethod
116	    def _passes_filters(
117	        doc: IndexedDoc,
118	        p: dict,
119	        schema: str | None,
120	        version: str | None,
121	        field_path: str | None,
122	        change_kind: str | None,
123	        compatibility: str | None,
124	        asset_terms: list[str],
125	    ) -> bool:
126	        if doc.doc_type == "change":
127	            if schema is not None and p["schema"] != schema:
128	                return False
129	            if version is not None and version not in (
130	                p["baseline_version"],
131	                p["candidate_version"],
132	            ):
133	                return False
134	            if field_path is not None and field_path not in (
135	                p["path"],
136	                p.get("old_path"),
137	                p.get("new_path"),
138	            ):
139	                return False
140	            if change_kind is not None and p["change_kind"] != change_kind:
141	                return False
142	            if compatibility is not None and p["compatibility"] != compatibility:
143	                return False
144	            if asset_terms:
145	                names = doc.tokens.get("impact_assets", frozenset())
146	                ids = doc.tokens.get("impact_asset_ids", frozenset())
147	                if not all(t in names or t in ids for t in asset_terms):
148	                    return False
149	        elif doc.doc_type == "schema":
150	            if schema is not None and p["name"] != schema:
151	                return False
152	            if version is not None and p["version"] != version:
153	                return False
154	            if field_path is not None or change_kind is not None or compatibility is not None:
155	                return False
156	            if asset_terms:
157	                return False
158	        elif doc.doc_type == "asset":
159	            if schema is not None and schema not in p["schemas"]:
160	                return False
161	            if version is not None and version not in p["versions"]:
162	                return False
163	            if field_path is not None or change_kind is not None or compatibility is not None:
164	                return False
165	            if asset_terms:
166	                toks = doc.tokens.get("name", frozenset())
167	                if not all(t in toks for t in asset_terms):
168	                    return False
169	        return True
170	
171	    @staticmethod
172	    def _asset_hit_fields(doc: IndexedDoc, asset_terms: list[str]) -> set[str]:
173	        hits: set[str] = set()
174	        for fname in ("impact_assets", "impact_asset_ids", "name"):
175	            toks = doc.tokens.get(fname)
176	            if toks and all(t in toks for t in asset_terms):
177	                hits.add(fname)
178	        return hits

1	"""字段路径工具。
2	
3	字段路径采用 JSON Pointer（RFC 6901）表示，例如 ``/properties/name``、
4	``/properties/a~1b``。根对象本身用空串 ``""`` 表示。
5	"""
6	
7	from __future__ import annotations
8	
9	from typing import Any
10	
11	
12	def escape(token: str) -> str:
13	    """转义单个路径段。"""
14	    return token.replace("~", "~0").replace("/", "~1")
15	
16	
17	def unescape(token: str) -> str:
18	    """反转义单个路径段。"""
19	    return token.replace("~1", "/").replace("~0", "~")
20	
21	
22	def parse(path: str) -> tuple[str, ...]:
23	    """把 JSON Pointer 解析为路径段元组；根路径返回空元组。"""
24	    if path == "":
25	        return ()
26	    if not path.startswith("/"):
27	        raise ValueError(f"非法 JSON Pointer: {path!r}")
28	    return tuple(unescape(seg) for seg in path[1:].split("/"))
29	
30	
31	def format(segments: tuple[str, ...] | list[str]) -> str:
32	    """把路径段组装为 JSON Pointer。"""
33	    return "".join("/" + escape(str(seg)) for seg in segments)
34	
35	
36	def child(path: str, segment: str) -> str:
37	    """返回某路径下的子路径。"""
38	    return (path + "/" + escape(segment)) if path else "/" + escape(segment)
39	
40	
41	def parent(path: str) -> str | None:
42	    """返回父路径；根路径返回 ``None``。"""
43	    segs = parse(path)
44	    if not segs:
45	        return None
46	    return format(segs[:-1])
47	
48	
49	def is_under(prefix: str, path: str) -> bool:
50	    """``path`` 是否位于 ``prefix`` 子树内（含自身）。"""
51	    p, c = parse(prefix), parse(path)
52	    return len(c) >= len(p) and c[: len(p)] == p
53	
54	
55	def resolve(doc: Any, path: str) -> Any:
56	    """在文档中按 JSON Pointer 取值，缺段/越界/类型不符时抛 KeyError。"""
57	    cur: Any = doc
58	    for seg in parse(path):
59	        if isinstance(cur, dict):
60	            if seg not in cur:
61	                raise KeyError(path)
62	            cur = cur[seg]
63	        elif isinstance(cur, list):
64	            try:
65	                idx = int(seg)
66	            except ValueError as exc:
67	                raise KeyError(path) from exc
68	            if not 0 <= idx < len(cur):
69	                raise KeyError(path)
70	            cur = cur[idx]
71	        else:
72	            raise KeyError(path)
73	    return cur
74	
75	
76	def normalize_field_pointer(path: str) -> str:
77	    """把 Schema 文档指针 *无上下文地* 规整为逻辑字段路径。
78	
79	    注意：纯文本规整无法区分「名为 ``items`` 的属性」与 ``items`` 关键字，
80	    资产/引用路径应优先使用逻辑路径，或用 :func:`resolve_logical` 结合
81	    文档解析。
82	    """
83	    segs = list(parse(path))
84	    out: list[str] = []
85	    for i, seg in enumerate(segs):
86	        if seg in ("properties", "prefixItems"):
87	            continue
88	        if seg == "additionalProperties":
89	            out.append("*")
90	        elif seg == "items":
91	            # 元组形式 items/0 展开为数组下标；单 Schema items 展开为 -。
92	            if i + 1 < len(segs) and segs[i + 1].isdigit():
93	                continue
94	            out.append("-")
95	        else:
96	            out.append(seg)
97	    return format(out)
98	
99	
100	def resolve_logical(document: Any, raw_path: str) -> str | None:
101	    """结合文档结构，把文档指针解析为逻辑字段路径；不可解析返回 ``None``。
102	
103	    遍历规则与字段展开一致：``properties`` 段省略（其后必为属性名，即使
104	    名字恰好叫 ``items``）；单 Schema ``items`` 段映射为 ``-``；
105	    ``additionalProperties`` 映射为 ``*``；``$defs``/``definitions`` 保留。
106	    """
107	    segs = parse(raw_path)
108	    node: Any = document
109	    logical: list[str] = []
110	    i = 0
111	    while i < len(segs):
112	        seg = segs[i]
113	        if isinstance(node, dict):
114	            props = node.get("properties")
115	            if seg == "properties" and isinstance(props, dict):
116	                # 容器关键字与其后的属性名在同一步消费，避免属性名与
117	                # Schema 关键字（如名为 items 的属性）混淆。
118	                if i + 1 >= len(segs):
119	                    return None
120	                name = segs[i + 1]
121	                if name not in props:
122	                    return None
123	                node = props[name]
124	                logical.append(name)
125	                i += 2
126	                continue
127	            pats = node.get("patternProperties")
128	            if seg == "patternProperties" and isinstance(pats, dict):
129	                if i + 1 >= len(segs):
130	                    return None
131	                name = segs[i + 1]
132	                if name not in pats:
133	                    return None
134	                node = pats[name]
135	                logical.append(escape(name))
136	                i += 2
137	                continue
138	            ap = node.get("additionalProperties")
139	            if seg == "additionalProperties" and isinstance(ap, (dict, bool)):
140	                node = ap
141	                logical.append("*")
142	                i += 1
143	                continue
144	            items = node.get("items")
145	            if seg == "items" and isinstance(items, (dict, bool)):
146	                node = items
147	                logical.append("-")
148	                i += 1
149	                continue
150	            pre = node.get("prefixItems")
151	            if seg == "prefixItems" and isinstance(pre, list):
152	                if i + 1 >= len(segs):
153	                    return None
154	                try:
155	                    idx = int(segs[i + 1])
156	                except ValueError:
157	                    return None
158	                if not 0 <= idx < len(pre):
159	                    return None
160	                node = pre[idx]
161	                logical.append(str(idx))
162	                i += 2
163	                continue
164	            if seg in ("$defs", "definitions") and isinstance(node.get(seg), dict):
165	                if i + 1 >= len(segs):
166	                    return None
167	                name = segs[i + 1]
168	                if name not in node[seg]:
169	                    return None
170	                node = node[seg][name]
171	                logical.extend((seg, name))
172	                i += 2
173	                continue
174	            if seg not in node:
175	                return None
176	            node = node[seg]
177	            logical.append(seg)
178	            i += 1
179	        elif isinstance(node, list):
180	            try:
181	                idx = int(seg)
182	            except ValueError:
183	                return None
184	            if not 0 <= idx < len(node):
185	                return None
186	            node = node[idx]
187	            logical.append(seg)
188	            i += 1
189	        else:
190	            return None
191	    return format(logical)

1	"""升级影响汇总。
2	
3	在字段级变更报告之上，按资产汇总一次 Schema 升级的影响：复用
4	:func:`meta_catalog.compare.build_report` 的全部比较语义（候选解析、字段对齐、
5	重命名、稳定排序与报告标识），不产生新的去重口径。
6	
7	每个资产对每条命中变更保留至多一条记录，命中方式 ``impact_kind``：
8	
9	  * ``direct``     资产直接引用了变更字段（出现在变更的直接影响资产中）；
10	  * ``transitive`` 资产经其他 Schema 传递引用了变更字段；
11	  * ``both``       同一变更上直接与传递同时命中。
12	
13	资产状态 ``status`` 按命中变更的最严重兼容结论取值，严重顺序为
14	``breaking`` > ``compatible`` > ``metadata``；没有任何命中时为 ``unaffected``。
15	汇总只读注册簿，不构造报告、不入检索索引、不改动任何注册内容。
16	"""
17	
18	from __future__ import annotations
19	
20	from typing import Any
21	
22	from . import compare as compare_mod
23	from .errors import NotFoundError
24	from .registry import Registry
25	
26	# status 严重顺序：下标越小越严重。
27	_SEVERITY = ("breaking", "compatible", "metadata")
28	_SEVERITY_RANK = {s: i for i, s in enumerate(_SEVERITY)}
29	
30	
31	def _resolve_asset_ids(
32	    registry: Registry, asset_ids: list[str] | None
33	) -> list[str]:
34	    """校验并去重资产选择，返回按 asset_id 升序的入选清单。
35	
36	    ``None`` 表示覆盖全部资产；未知资产抛 :class:`NotFoundError`。
37	    """
38	    if asset_ids is None:
39	        return [a.id for a in registry.all_assets()]
40	    unique: set[str] = set()
41	    for aid in asset_ids:
42	        if not isinstance(aid, str) or not aid:
43	            raise NotFoundError(
44	                f"资产 {aid!r} 不存在", details={"asset": aid}
45	            )
46	        if aid in unique:
47	            continue
48	        registry.get_asset(aid)  # 未知资产抛 NotFoundError
49	        unique.add(aid)
50	    return sorted(unique)
51	
52	
53	def build_upgrade_report(
54	    registry: Registry,
55	    name: str,
56	    baseline_version: str,
57	    candidate_document: Any,
58	    candidate_version: str | None,
59	    renames: list | None,
60	    asset_ids: list[str] | None,
61	) -> dict[str, Any]:
62	    """构造升级影响汇总（不触碰注册内容、报告库与检索索引）。"""
63	    # 比较语义与 compare_schemas 完全一致：内部做字段数/变更数/影响链限制校验。
64	    report = compare_mod.build_report(
65	        registry,
66	        name,
67	        baseline_version,
68	        candidate_document,
69	        candidate_version,
70	        renames,
71	    )
72	
73	    # 比较输入校验通过后再校验资产选择（未知资产抛 NotFoundError）。
74	    selected = _resolve_asset_ids(registry, asset_ids)
75	
76	    assets = {a.id: a for a in registry.all_assets()}
77	
78	    # 每个入选资产收集 (变更索引, impact_kind)；同一变更只保留一条。
79	    hits: dict[str, dict[int, str]] = {aid: {} for aid in selected}
80	    hit_paths: set[str] = set()
81	    for i, change in enumerate(report["changes"]):
82	        direct_ids = {a["asset_id"] for a in change["direct_assets"]}
83	        transitive_ids = {a["asset_id"] for a in change["transitive_assets"]}
84	        for aid in selected:
85	            is_direct = aid in direct_ids
86	            is_transitive = aid in transitive_ids
87	            if not is_direct and not is_transitive:
88	                continue
89	            impact_kind = (
90	                "both" if is_direct and is_transitive
91	                else "direct" if is_direct
92	                else "transitive"
93	            )
94	            hits[aid][i] = impact_kind
95	            hit_paths.add(change["path"])
96	
97	    asset_entries: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
98	    counts = {s: 0 for s in _SEVERITY}
99	    for aid in selected:
100	        asset = assets[aid]
101	        per_change = hits[aid]
102	        if not per_change:
103	            asset_entries.append(
104	                {
105	                    "asset_id": aid,
106	                    "name": asset.name,
107	                    "kind": asset.kind,
108	                    "status": "unaffected",
109	                    "changes": [],
110	                }
111	            )
112	            continue
113	
114	        status = ""
115	        rank = len(_SEVERITY)
116	        changes_out: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
117	        # 变更沿用报告的稳定排序：按报告中的索引升序遍历。
118	        for i, change in enumerate(report["changes"]):
119	            impact_kind = per_change.get(i)
120	            if impact_kind is None:
121	                continue
122	            entry = {k: change[k] for k in change}
123	            entry["impact_kind"] = impact_kind
124	            changes_out.append(entry)
125	            comp = change["compatibility"]
126	            comp_rank = _SEVERITY_RANK.get(comp, len(_SEVERITY))
127	            if comp_rank < rank:
128	                rank = comp_rank
129	                status = comp
130	
131	        counts[status] += 1
132	        asset_entries.append(
133	            {
134	                "asset_id": aid,
135	                "name": asset.name,
136	                "kind": asset.kind,
137	                "status": status,
138	                "changes": changes_out,
139	            }
140	        )
141	
142	    unaffected = len(selected) - sum(counts.values())
143	    return {
144	        "report_id": report["report_id"],
145	        "schema": report["schema"],
146	        "baseline_version": report["baseline_version"],
147	        "candidate_version": report["candidate_version"],
148	        "summary": {
149	            "asset_total": len(selected),
150	            "breaking_assets": counts["breaking"],
151	            "compatible_assets": counts["compatible"],
152	            "metadata_assets": counts["metadata"],
153	            "unaffected_assets": unaffected,
154	            "changed_paths": len(hit_paths),
155	        },
156	        "assets": asset_entries,
157	    }

"""升级影响汇总。

在字段级变更报告之上，按资产汇总一次 Schema 升级的影响：复用
:func:`meta_catalog.compare.build_report` 的全部比较语义（候选解析、字段对齐、
重命名、稳定排序与报告标识），不产生新的去重口径。

每个资产对每条命中变更保留至多一条记录，命中方式 ``impact_kind``：

  * ``direct``     资产直接引用了变更字段（出现在变更的直接影响资产中）；
  * ``transitive`` 资产经其他 Schema 传递引用了变更字段；
  * ``both``       同一变更上直接与传递同时命中。

资产状态 ``status`` 按命中变更的最严重兼容结论取值，严重顺序为
``breaking`` > ``compatible`` > ``metadata``；没有任何命中时为 ``unaffected``。
汇总只读注册簿，不构造报告、不入检索索引、不改动任何注册内容。
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

from . import compare as compare_mod
from .errors import NotFoundError
from .registry import Registry

# status 严重顺序：下标越小越严重。
_SEVERITY = ("breaking", "compatible", "metadata")
_SEVERITY_RANK = {s: i for i, s in enumerate(_SEVERITY)}


def _resolve_asset_ids(
    registry: Registry, asset_ids: list[str] | None
) -> list[str]:
    """校验并去重资产选择，返回按 asset_id 升序的入选清单。

    ``None`` 表示覆盖全部资产；未知资产抛 :class:`NotFoundError`。
    """
    if asset_ids is None:
        return [a.id for a in registry.all_assets()]
    unique: set[str] = set()
    for aid in asset_ids:
        if not isinstance(aid, str) or not aid:
            raise NotFoundError(
                f"资产 {aid!r} 不存在", details={"asset": aid}
            )
        if aid in unique:
            continue
        registry.get_asset(aid)  # 未知资产抛 NotFoundError
        unique.add(aid)
    return sorted(unique)


def build_upgrade_report(
    registry: Registry,
    name: str,
    baseline_version: str,
    candidate_document: Any,
    candidate_version: str | None,
    renames: list | None,
    asset_ids: list[str] | None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """构造升级影响汇总（不触碰注册内容、报告库与检索索引）。"""
    # 比较语义与 compare_schemas 完全一致：内部做字段数/变更数/影响链限制校验。
    report = compare_mod.build_report(
        registry,
        name,
        baseline_version,
        candidate_document,
        candidate_version,
        renames,
    )

    # 比较输入校验通过后再校验资产选择（未知资产抛 NotFoundError）。
    selected = _resolve_asset_ids(registry, asset_ids)

    assets = {a.id: a for a in registry.all_assets()}

    # 每个入选资产收集 (变更索引, impact_kind)；同一变更只保留一条。
    hits: dict[str, dict[int, str]] = {aid: {} for aid in selected}
    hit_paths: set[str] = set()
    for i, change in enumerate(report["changes"]):
        direct_ids = {a["asset_id"] for a in change["direct_assets"]}
        transitive_ids = {a["asset_id"] for a in change["transitive_assets"]}
        for aid in selected:
            is_direct = aid in direct_ids
            is_transitive = aid in transitive_ids
            if not is_direct and not is_transitive:
                continue
            impact_kind = (
                "both" if is_direct and is_transitive
                else "direct" if is_direct
                else "transitive"
            )
            hits[aid][i] = impact_kind
            hit_paths.add(change["path"])

    asset_entries: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    counts = {s: 0 for s in _SEVERITY}
    for aid in selected:
        asset = assets[aid]
        per_change = hits[aid]
        if not per_change:
            asset_entries.append(
                {
                    "asset_id": aid,
                    "name": asset.name,
                    "kind": asset.kind,
                    "status": "unaffected",
                    "changes": [],
                }
            )
            continue

        status = ""
        rank = len(_SEVERITY)
        changes_out: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        # 变更沿用报告的稳定排序：按报告中的索引升序遍历。
        for i, change in enumerate(report["changes"]):
            impact_kind = per_change.get(i)
            if impact_kind is None:
                continue
            entry = {k: change[k] for k in change}
            entry["impact_kind"] = impact_kind
            changes_out.append(entry)
            comp = change["compatibility"]
            comp_rank = _SEVERITY_RANK.get(comp, len(_SEVERITY))
            if comp_rank < rank:
                rank = comp_rank
                status = comp

        counts[status] += 1
        asset_entries.append(
            {
                "asset_id": aid,
                "name": asset.name,
                "kind": asset.kind,
                "status": status,
                "changes": changes_out,
            }
        )

    unaffected = len(selected) - sum(counts.values())
    return {
        "report_id": report["report_id"],
        "schema": report["schema"],
        "baseline_version": report["baseline_version"],
        "candidate_version": report["candidate_version"],
        "summary": {
            "asset_total": len(selected),
            "breaking_assets": counts["breaking"],
            "compatible_assets": counts["compatible"],
            "metadata_assets": counts["metadata"],
            "unaffected_assets": unaffected,
            "changed_paths": len(hit_paths),
        },
        "assets": asset_entries,
    }
